items.title: Elf Reading with a Hedgehog
items.alt: White-haired cartoon elf seated on a stump and showing an open blank storybook to a small scarf-wearing hedgehog.
items.description: The friendly hedgehog looks up beside the elf's red lace-up shoes. A cream-sleeved green outfit and red folded cap frame the open book between them.

items.title: Elf Walking a Christmas Cargo Bicycle
items.alt: Black-curled cartoon elf in green short overalls walking beside a red cargo bicycle carrying wrapped Christmas gifts.
items.description: One hand holds the handlebar beside the loaded wooden cargo box. A wreath with a gold bell decorates its front, while the elf steps forward in bright red curled shoes.

items.title: Three Christmas Elves Ice Skating
items.alt: Three different green-clothed cartoon elves holding hands in a curved skating chain, each wearing complete silver-bladed skates.
items.description: A curly-haired elf leads two smaller companions with dark braids and a red fringe. Different green outfits, hats and striped or plain leggings give each skater a distinct identity.

items.title: Elf Flying a Christmas Kite
items.alt: Braided cartoon elf in a green tunic holding a red-and-green diamond kite and its connected string spool.
items.description: The kite's red ribbon tail curves beside the elf's raised hand. Blue eyes, a star-tipped green cap and brown curled shoes distinguish the cheerful standing figure.

items.title: Elf Rinsing a Paintbrush
items.alt: Curly-haired cartoon elf seated on a red gift, rinsing a brush in a small bowl beside a jar of paintbrushes.
items.description: Water droplets rise beside the brush as it touches the bowl. A red sash, striped stockings and buckled brown boots distinguish the green-clothed character.

items.title: Elf Planning a Gift Delivery Route
items.alt: Black-haired cartoon elf kneeling beside a red gift sack, holding a compass and pointing to a tree-marked imaginary map.
items.description: A dotted route winds between green tree symbols on the cream map. The elf's compass, red cap and full sack of toys create a clear fictional delivery-planning scene.
